t: NixOS LAN Services: Declarative HTTPS with Caddy
s: This article details restoring NixOS services, specifically Trilium Notes, after a system crash by leveraging declarative configuration and migrating to an AI assistant (Gemini 3) with full context for precise restoration.
sub: NixOS system recovery and declarative configuration management
Restoring Trilium Notes service with systemd and user activation scripts
Context-driven AI interaction ('Prompt Fu' & 4E Protocol) for system repair
Modularizing NixOS configurations into dedicated .nix files (e.g., services.nix)
